$ edit b/corpus_test.go  # a package b over the corpus
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # transforms
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    script/errs/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base's do/ tree already errs
    script/garbled/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base states malformed, which looped neither gives nor keeps
    script/garbled/transform/upper: upper declines the base: the base states malformed, which upper neither gives nor keeps

$ go test ./b  # tr-b-jenny
    script/errs/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base's do/ tree already errs
    script/errs/transform/upper: Uppercases every file under do/out/.
        copy: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        transform/upper/out/copy/values.txt differs (-golden +got):
          PARTIAL
        - PARTIAL
        FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... runs copy on another value than this run: it runs the variant on what upper makes now, where a normal run reads the inputs the archive holds. Run it, fix what it reports, and read the diff before committing.
    script/errs/transform/upper: Uppercases every file under do/out/.
        A cell of the variant failed, and the archive's inputs for upper's variant, which a normal run reads, differ from what upper makes now:
        transform/upper/in/do/out/values.txt differs (-committed +made):
          PARTIAL
        + PARTIAL
        The module's update, FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./..., rewrites them, in the package that owns upper. If no package owns upper, no update rewrites the inputs.
    script/garbled/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base states malformed, which looped neither gives nor keeps
    script/garbled/transform/upper: upper declines the base: the base states malformed, which upper neither gives nor keeps
    script/twice/transform/upper: Uppercases every file under do/out/.
        copy: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        transform/upper/out/copy/values.txt differs (-golden +got):
          A1 SIX
        - A1 SIX
        FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... runs copy on another value than this run: it runs the variant on what upper makes now, where a normal run reads the inputs the archive holds. Run it, fix what it reports, and read the diff before committing.
    script/twice/transform/upper: Uppercases every file under do/out/.
        A cell of the variant failed, and the archive's inputs for upper's variant, which a normal run reads, differ from what upper makes now:
        transform/upper/in/do/out/values.txt differs (-committed +made):
          A1 SIX
        + A1 SIX
        The module's update, FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./..., rewrites them, in the package that owns upper. If no package owns upper, no update rewrites the inputs.
